findings.claim: CLI help and implementation do not need generated-key changes in this slice.
findings.evidence: packages/emulate/src/commands/start.ts calls seedFromConfig directly, which throws an actionable error when private_key is omitted; docs explicitly retain the CLI requirement.

findings.claim: GitHub App JWT verification loses diagnostic signal in a pre-existing empty catch.
findings.evidence: packages/@emulators/core/src/middleware/auth.ts catches key derivation or verification errors without debug logging while still failing safely with 401.

findings.claim: The app insertion loop contains a defensive private_key validation after atomic pre-validation.
findings.evidence: packages/@emulators/github/src/index.ts validates all app keys before store mutation and validates the narrowed value again immediately before insertion.

exemptions.evidence: CLI generation and delivery are outside scope, and direct CLI seeding fails explicitly when a key is omitted.

exemptions.claim: Next and Nuxt adapters remain unchanged.
exemptions.evidence: Their direct seed calls fail explicitly instead of generating inaccessible key material.

issue_candidates.title: Log GitHub App JWT verification failures in debug mode
issue_candidates.evidence: The pre-existing catch in packages/@emulators/core/src/middleware/auth.ts fails safely but emits no diagnostic.
issue_candidates.why_out_of_scope: The catch predates this slice and the authentication result remains correct.

issue_candidates.title: Simplify redundant GitHub App private key validation
issue_candidates.evidence: Atomic pre-validation makes the later omitted-key branch defensive and ordinarily unreachable.
issue_candidates.why_out_of_scope: The second guard is harmless and preserves local type narrowing.
